# Western Dental Academy

Western Dental Academy (WDA) is a professional development organization for dental professionals located in Sherwood Park (Edmonton Area), Alberta, Canada.

## What We Do
WDA offers professional development opportunities including:
- Hands-on workshops for registered dental assistants and dental professionals
- Guest speaker events featuring dental industry experts
- Online and in-person courses
- National Board Guided Practice Workshops for NDAEB CPE preparation
- Ergonomics in Dentistry workshops (1.5 hours, $40 CAD)

## Who We Serve
- Registered Dental Assistants (RDAs) in Alberta
- Dental hygienists, dentists, and dental team members
- Dental assisting graduates preparing for NDAEB certification
- Dental professionals in rural and remote Alberta communities

## CADA CCP Support
WDA workshops are designed to support the CADA Continuing Competence Program (CCP). Participants receive a certificate of attendance to support their annual CCP submission.

## Location
150 Chippewa Road, Suite 258
Sherwood Park, Alberta (Edmonton Area)
Free parking available
